regression_origin.subject: fix: port complete package symbol model
regression_origin.evidence: The dedicated object renderer blob is unchanged from the green baseline through the current revision; this commit made any braced namespace or package-like symbol force class-factory dispatch.

java_locations.role: Objects, maps, classes, packages, and namespaces share one command grammar and semantic diagram factory.
After shared parsing, dispatches an OBJECT leaf to EntityImageObject rather than treating shared grammar ownership as class rendering.
Owns the object-specific header/body dimensions and paint.
Materializes a dotted namespace path while attaching declaration location only to the declared group, not synthesized ancestors.

rust_locations.role: Conflates acceptance by the shared class-diagram grammar with selection of Diagram::Class whenever a braced package or namespace is present.
Already implements the exact object-specific header/body model and synthesized-ancestor source-location distinction.
The wrongly selected backend uses a generic class header envelope six pixels taller for these object leaves.

claimed_invariant: Shared class-diagram grammar viability and renderer backend selection are separate decisions. A diagram containing only object/map leaves inside ordinary object-compatible package or namespace containers remains an object diagram; class-only leaves, package symbols, allowmixing, or incompatible mixed constructs select the class backend.
causal_divergence: Rust's has_class_symbol_container flag raises the class score above all competitors for every braced package or namespace. Four object-only container diagrams therefore bypass the exact object renderer and enter the class renderer, gaining six pixels per object header and incorrect synthesized-ancestor source metadata. Java shares parsing but later dispatches each leaf by LeafType.
planned_model_change: Replace container-presence forcing with semantic backend evidence: track native object/map leaves, class-only or mixed constructs, and whether every container is an ordinary object-compatible package or namespace. Preserve class dispatch for genuine package symbols and mixed diagrams. Select Diagram::Object only when the leaf and container model is wholly object-compatible. Do not change object dimensions or add fixture-specific dispatch names.
perturbation_axes: package versus aliased package versus dotted and explicitly nested namespaces
ordinary containers versus explicit package symbols
namespace depth, siblings, reopenings, and declaration order
no links versus intra-container and cross-container links
implicit versus explicit ancestor source locations
